Repair-04 holds on the four prior loci. No high defect is in the embedded text. Two medium first-failure contradictions remain. The packet stays specified-only: zero consumer executions, and W-D2 / Sprint 1 stay open.

## Evidence limits

This review uses only the embedded bytes. Manifest and receipt SHA-256 values were not recomputed. `history/pre-grok-repair-04` and the prior packet `6c316122…` were not in the packet, so “13 new” and “unchanged oracles” were not diffed. No parser, codec, Core, or consumer was executed. Dependency behavior below is from the embedded Source parser, Core preparer, wire codec, and effect codec. One reviewer pass; a second provider was not run.

## Specified-only, gates open

`implementationExists` is false, `implementationFiles` is `[]`, `consumerTestsExecuted` is false, and `observedLocalSemanticComparisons` / `observedFullConsumerSuccesses` are 0. All six positives are `specified-only-this-sprint` with `fullConsumerPositive: specified-only-blocked`. All 150 hostile rows and 11 inspections are `specified-only-not-executed`. Local success is `SemanticComparedUnqualified` with `publishedPost` / `publishedEffects` null and B17 pending. Ledger mode is a separate later reject. V-S0-01 and F-S0-01 set `normativeWD2Adopted` false. Wire, effect-wire, and Source/6 text leave W-D2 and Sprint 1 open. This review does not close them.

## Counts and schedule that match

| Check | Embedded result |
| --- | --- |
| Phase order | F-wire, F-source, D, M, H, C, I, E, L |
| Positives | 6: transfer-fee, transfer-zero-fee, repay-30, repay-accrued-only, repay-settled, repay-near-bound |
| Hostile ids | 150 distinct |
| Inspections | 11 |
| Signed map | header + tags 1–35 |
| Nested operation fields | 14 |
| Bindings | B01–B17; anchors B01–B16; B17 absent from M |
| Relations | V-S0-01 at tag 1; F-S0-01 at tag 27; cross-vocabulary equality is off |
| C handoff | `prepareMil4S0(B11 snapshot cells/work, lowered intent, lowerer-transformed submitted effects, B15 successor, TerminalSuccess)`; `consumedReplay` is `B16.completeReplayHistory`; wrapper, `lowered.state`, replay shortcut `[]`/`[selectedKey]`, `signedDigest`, and `localStipulation` are excluded |

Reading B is the same in PLAN, FIELD-MAP, EXPECTATIONS, RESULT, and the receipt. Late out-of-domain owner beats B01 (`late-domain-beats-b01`). Late in-domain recipient mismatch does not (`late-mismatch-does-not-beat-b01`). Literal agreement mismatch beats unavailable B01. B10’s anchor is asset/tag 16. H overflow is `EffectDomainRejected/W_D2F_REPLAY_HISTORY_BOUND` with cap 16, no truncation, and `imageSide` derived; supplied overflow is the same code with `imageSide` supplied, and replayBefore wins when both counts overflow. Image codec failures stay `EffectImageRejected` with the original code (`SHAPE`, `INTEGER`, `VARIANT`, `LENGTH`). Field 26 is checked only after full image equality. Rehash of an incomplete image stays `W_D2F_PREPARED_IMAGE_MISMATCH`.

Positive image lengths and commitments match the embedded W-D2E fixtures (583/`bc633665…`, 560/`ed5b4bff…`, 688/`e8b64f93…`, 688/`90b113d7…`, 688/`006f01a1…`, 688/`f0889508…`). Near-bound arithmetic matches Core: repay 1 against principal `2^127−2` and accrued 1, creditor and allowance spent land on `2^128−1`. `derived-record-byte-bound` matches the effect codec: a 64-byte id is 66 bytes on the wire, two ids plus a 32-byte hash is 164, and replayBefore 15 plus replayAfter 16 plus four u128 counters is 5152 bytes, so record cap 4096 fails with `LENGTH` after H’s 15/16 counts pass. Current full-path first failure on these fixtures is B01 at tag 3; `actionId` `Action` versus `TransferLiteralFee` / `RepayAccrualFirst` is tag 6, so it does not beat B01, and those fixtures still cannot become future positives.

Isolated Core rows match the preparer order stage → intent → effect/`sameEffects` → authority → history → failure. `sameEffectsMustPass` matches that order (`S0_EFFECT_RANGE` and `S0_INTENT_*` before `sameEffects`; `S0_AUTH_SCOPE`, `S0_HISTORY_*`, and `S0_FAILURE_UNSUPPORTED` after it).

## Prior four mediums

They are closed in this text, against the embedded modules.

1. **preHead sourcePath.** `prehead-mismatch` and `prehead-intent-before-snapshot-claim` use `sourcePath` `intent.preHead`. `prehead-snapshot-claim-before-evidence` uses `authenticated.head`. `genuine-different-snapshot-head` uses `sourcePath` null and `factPath` `B11.snapshot.head`.
2. **AdvanceHead index.** The parser’s vector is debit, credit, optional transfer credit, optional repay `set_obligation`, allowance, replay, advance. Canonical fee-positive transfer and repay are index 5; zero-fee transfer without the extra credit is index 4. `source-fee0-noncanonical-vector-head-domain` is index 5 with fee 0 plus a parsed credit. `source-fee1-noncanonical-vector-head-domain` is index 4 with fee 1 and no credit. Fee is not the index rule. D is before C.
3. **B11 facts.** Integrity failure is `W_D2F_EVIDENCE_INVALID` at `preHead` (`invalid-snapshot-proof-before-core-domain-asset`, `wrong-snapshot`). Then core → `W_D2F_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED` / `coreVersion` / `B11.snapshot.core`; domain, asset, and head → `W_D2F_FIELD_MISMATCH` with `B11.snapshot.domain|asset|head`. A snapshot `moriarty-core/6` no longer falls through to Core `S0_STAGE_UNSUPPORTED`.
4. **B13 versus B16.** Genuine consumed status is `W_D2F_REPLAY_CONSUMED` at tag 20 for both Source `unused` and Source `consumed`. Invalid B13 proof stays `W_D2F_EVIDENCE_INVALID`. After a real unused B13, B16 order is canonical triple, then domain/signer/nonce, then first duplicate `W_D2F_HISTORY_DUPLICATE`, then selected membership `W_D2F_REPLAY_HISTORY_INCONSISTENT` with `selectedIndex`, then Source `authenticated.replay`. `9D`, `9O`, `h0`, spaced JSON, and a duplicate tuple all reject in M. B16’s id subset (`[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}`, reserved words out, nonce 64 lowercase hex) is inside Core `replayId`, so those rows do not become `S0_STAGE_UNSUPPORTED`.

## Medium defects

**M1. Repay debtor and creditor oracles skip the Source claim they say runs first.**

Tag 35 order is Source claim, then retained B11 obligation. `repay-debtor-mismatch` and `repay-creditor-mismatch` still expect `sourcePath` null and `retainedFactBinding` `B11`.

The debtor mutation is wire `X` versus snapshot debtor `O`. Source formation requires `obligation.debtor === signer`. After tag 13, signer is the Source signer, so Source debtor is that signer. On the ordinary fixture that signer is `O`, so wire `X` fails the Source claim before the snapshot fact. The B11 oracle is unreachable for that mutation.

Creditor is the same shape: “never replace C” plus wire `X` fails Source creditor `C` before the snapshot fact. `predecessor-mismatch` already pins the fact-locus setup (“Source matches wire; verified fact differs”). `repay-payer-mismatch` already records a Source-claim miss without a B11 binding. The debtor and creditor rows do neither.

**M2. Two mixed literal mismatches are labeled as retained-fact failures.**

Per-tag order compares the direct Source literal before the retained fact. `scale-field-mismatch` is wire scale 2 versus Source scale 3, and the oracle still has `retainedFactBinding` `B10`. `coreprogram-field-mismatch` is wire `RepayAccrualFirst` versus Source `TransferLiteralFee`, and the oracle still has `retainedFactBinding` `B04`. The literal check fails before that fact comparison.

The pure fact rows are already separate and consistent: `auth-scale-mismatch-with-equal-claims`, `auth-core-id-mismatch-with-equal-claims`, `auth-sourcehash-mismatch-with-equal-claims`, `keyref-resolution-mismatch`, and `predecessor-mismatch`. `action-field-mismatch` is the literal pattern and carries no retained binding. The two mixed rows collapse that distinction.

## Low notes

RESULT’s opening “high ambiguity” sits beside the same file’s “four medium findings.” H’s step-5 diagnostic list omits `imageSide`; step 7 and the H rows set `imageSide` `derived`. Submitted `use_replay` text is outside the D hash32 list; a non-nonce key dies at C as `S0_EFFECT_MISMATCH`. B15 has no genuine fact-mismatch oracle with field, sourcePath, and factPath. `DOMAIN_UNSUPPORTED` also covers a bad history nonce; the `.nonce` suffix distinguishes it. Zero-outstanding Source status `Outstanding` can still reach Core `S0_STAGE_UNSUPPORTED`. The inspection object remains specified while PLAN says not to build that API in this sprint.
